content: Hello! This is Ms. Carter from the administration office. How can I assist you today with your tuition payment records or account details?
Hi, I just want to check if my spring tuition payment went through. I sent $2,400 last Friday via Zelle.
Thank you for letting me know. I see a Zelle transfer for $2,400 credited to your student account on May 31, 2024, under the name Daniel H. with reference code ZL7321SPR. That matches our records.
Perfect, because I used my student ID 1005891 in the memo line. Can you confirm it's attached to my profile?
Yes, Daniel, student ID 1005891 was correctly included in the transaction memo, and the system automatically linked it to your account. Everything is up to date on your profile.
Great. I also need a receipt emailed to my address, daniel.hughes92@gmail.com, for my records.
Absolutely! I'll send a payment confirmation and official receipt to daniel.hughes92@gmail.com within the next hour, as tuition proof is often needed for scholarship deadlines.
Thanks. If it's possible to include my full address, 1247 Cedar Lane, Apt 3A, Springfield, OH 45503, that'd be helpful for my financial aid file.
Noted. I will include your full address, 1247 Cedar Lane, Apt 3A, Springfield, OH 45503, on the receipt. Watch for the email soon, as some aid offices are strict about document timing.
